info.title: Rayon API
info.description: Managed public header generation, with optional private material overrides. Omit scripts and material_ref to select current material from a registered HTTPS source; arbitrary URLs are not fetched on demand. Exact UTF-8 body preserved; null differs from empty. Successful generation spends one allowance call; failed generation releases its reserved allowance and wallet funds. Validation and capacity rejection are free. Usage is free and separately limited to 60 requests per minute. Paid subscription allowances reset at their verified billing-week expiry without rollover; enterprise weekly allocations reset without rollover; owners and custom allowances reset Monday 00:00 UTC. Preloaded USD wallet funds do not expire. Available complimentary trial/bonus calls are consumed first, then paid weekly calls, then wallet funds at standard $5 per 1,000 successful calls or the eligible paid tier rate ($3.50/$2.50/$2/$1.50). Failed generations return their recorded reservations; the wallet never goes negative. No daily or monthly request cap. Uploads support identity/gzip with 4 MiB compressed and expanded limits. Unknown fields, duplicate/prototype keys, nonfinite numbers and excessive nesting rejected. Active shape uploads and generation share bounded process capacity. Short bursts may wait briefly before admission; queue overflow and persistent capacity pressure reject before body reads or generation credit reservations. Upload reads have a 20-second deadline. JSON structure is limited to 4096 nodes including object member names; script strings are opaque. Preparation is optional, requires explicit material and is separately bounded and uncharged. Validated usable mappings can be ready with defaulted internal records; required generated output validation is unchanged.

403.description: access_denied with account, policy or domain reason; existing policies_required and domain_not_approved codes remain valid

error.message: Access to api.example.com has not been approved.
error.action: Request access to this domain in your dashboard.

422.description: invalid_input, unsupported_profile, unsupported_material, material_expired, generation_failed, generation_incomplete, generation_invalid_headers, generation_invalid_form or output_too_large. Known worker failure codes are preserved. Read message/action for guidance and retain request_id; a generation failure alone does not establish incorrect client input.

429.description: rate_limited: slow requests; concurrency_exceeded: reduce in-flight requests; capacity_exceeded: wait for service capacity. Respect Retry-After.

error.message: Too many requests are running at once.
error.action: Wait for running requests to finish, then retry.

503.description: credits_warming: temporary credit preparation, retryable true with Retry-After: 1; or generation_unavailable

error.action: Wait a moment, then retry. Contact support if this continues.

200.description: Generated telemetry for the requested header or form mode; target acceptance is not verified.

408.description: input_timeout; upload deadline exceeded without generation charge

402.description: insufficient_credits: top up the wallet or wait for allowance renewal

error.message: No available allowance or sufficient wallet balance remains.
error.action: Top up your wallet or add an active allowance in your dashboard.

409.description: After prepared-only enforcement: material_not_prepared, material_learning or prepared_material_expired; no successful generation charge. Prepare or resume waiting explicitly.

get.summary: Read usage and limits without generation charge

post.summary: Prepare supplied material for subsequent Rust generation
post.description: Optionally prepare explicit material and full context before a workload. Requires scripts or material_ref. Returns safe readiness metadata, never generated telemetry. Validated usable mappings with defaults may become ready; required output validation and publication still apply.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Use the same key and identical input only when retrying this preparation operation.

200.description: Current preparation status; no generation credit is spent.

202.description: Current preparation status; no generation credit is spent.

get.summary: Get or explicitly wait for material preparation status
get.description: Authenticated and key-isolated. Client timeout or cancellation detaches only that waiter, leaving the shared operation active. Status reads never restart learning. Preparation/status spend no generation credits.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Optional bounded long poll until ready/terminal state, returning a snapshot at the wait deadline.

200.description: Current preparation status; no generation credit is spent.

data_url.title: Data Url
data_url.description: Valid PNG data URL with bounded strict base64, CRC-checked chunks and image stream; each dimension at most 8192, at most 16 Mi pixels. Full effective profile stays within 64 KiB UTF-8.

inline.description: True for source embedded in the document; url identifies that document and currentScript.src remains empty.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Required source-page URL. Managed selection uses a registered HTTPS source on port 443. Explicit references must match their original source URL.

scripts.description: Optional explicit override: complete ordered JavaScript, 1–16 scripts, 2 MiB each / 3 MiB total. Supply scripts or material_ref, never both. Omit both for managed header generation.

material_ref.description: Optional private API-key-scoped source reference. Do not pin this field in managed flows; leave both material fields omitted to select updates.

document_cookie.title: Document Cookie
document_cookie.description: JavaScript-visible cookies only, at most 16 KiB; never retained in material cache.

mode.description: Header mode (the default) returns HTTP telemetry headers. Form mode runs form instrumentation and returns body fields.

form.description: Form mode only. Optional observed form ID and name; omitting this object creates the selected form without either attribute.

ShapeRequest.title: ShapeRequest

content_type.description: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, optionally with one UTF-8 charset parameter.

body.description: Exact encoded application body before telemetry insertion; an empty string is permitted. At most 256 KiB UTF-8, 1,024 decoded pairs and 256 UTF-8 bytes per field name. Preserve duplicate fields, order and empty values. Malformed percent escapes, invalid UTF-8, NUL and a complete stale telemetry family are rejected.

ShapeRequest.description: For registered public header sources, omit both material fields. Explicit material overrides automatic selection and remains private. Form mode requires an explicit material field. Null/empty material values and both fields together are invalid.

ShapeResponse.description: Transport-specific output: header and form properties are mutually exclusive. Metadata meanings are unchanged. Generation does not establish target acceptance.

daily_used.description: Legacy admitted-attempt analytics only; no daily or monthly cap is enforced.

monthly_used.description: Legacy admitted-attempt analytics only; no daily or monthly cap is enforced.

requests_per_second.description: Effective account-wide RPS across all keys: trial ceiling 15, general default 500, enterprise default 5000 with administrator overrides up to 10000. Lower account limits and service capacity still apply. Verified paid purchases remove trial-only caps while complimentary calls remain.

weekly_used.description: Spent and currently reserved calls in the current allowance period.

prepaid_remaining.description: Deprecated standard-rate call equivalent of available wallet funds ($5 per 1,000); use wallet.balance_usd and the current PAYG rate. Deferred legacy conversions may still expose their original call count.

balance_micro_usd.description: Exact available balance in millionths of one USD.

payg_rate_per_1000_usd.description: Standard PAYG or the newest eligible paid period rate per 1,000 successful generations, after weekly allowance.

legacy_prepaid_deprecated.description: Legacy prepaid-call fields are deprecated; display authoritative wallet funds.

bonus_remaining.description: Available unrevoked complimentary calls; separate from paid weekly calls and wallet funds.

trial_remaining.description: Available unrevoked complimentary calls; separate from paid weekly calls and wallet funds.

complimentary_remaining.description: Available unrevoked complimentary calls; separate from paid weekly calls and wallet funds.

trial_ends_at.description: Deprecated compatibility field; null for current complimentary credits. Does not alter account access expiry or create renewal charges.

expires_at.description: Null for current complimentary credits; historical timestamps are retained for compatibility.

message.description: Safe explanation without internal exception details.

retryable.description: Optional temporary-error guidance; this flag alone does not cause automatic retries. SDK 1.1.4+ retries once only after HTTP 422 material_expired with billing_status not_charged and retained original scripts. Check history after a timeout or pending/unknown billing outcome.

reason.description: Specific cause, such as account_disabled, account_expired, policies_required, domain_not_approved or domain_pending. Existing error codes are preserved.

action.description: Safe next step for the caller.

domain.description: Rejected hostname. A root domain and its www alias share approval; other subdomains require explicit approval.

field.description: Request field involved, such as source_url or request.url.

billing_status.description: not_charged: no allowance or wallet funds were used. pending: the billing record is still updating. unknown or absent: billing could not be confirmed. Check history before resubmitting.

id.description: Optional observed form id; control characters are forbidden.

name.description: Optional observed form name; control characters are forbidden.

headers.description: Complete customer-specific same-prefix a/b/c/d/f/z family with one optional same-family a0 header when the selected material emits it during this generation. All six core suffixes are required; suffixes and prefixes compare case-insensitively, with no duplicate suffixes. Original header names, values and case are preserved. Header names use ASCII HTTP token characters and need no X- prefix. Values contain only ASCII bytes 0x21 through 0x7e with no whitespace; d may be empty, and a0 must be nonempty. Other numbered suffixes are not accepted. Generation does not assert target acceptance. Both separated (prefix-a) and compact (prefixa) material header names are preserved exactly.

profile_used.description: Effective supported browser identity; canvas pixels and document cookies are excluded.

material_expires_at.description: Five-minute immutable material expiry, UTC. References are scoped to this API key.

path.description: Optional execution path. Use fallback_reason to detect fallback, not generation time.

material_reuse.description: Whether the resolved source material was reused.

discovery_duration_ms.description: Optional learning duration in milliseconds, including fractional values.

discovery_state.description: Optional learning state; current values include not_started, pending, complete, failed and restored.

fallback_reason.description: Non-null means a fallback was used. Contact support with request_id about the mapping issue.

fallback_message.description: Optional safe guidance when a fallback is used.

profile_used.description: Effective supported browser identity; canvas pixels and document cookies are excluded.

material_expires_at.description: Five-minute immutable material expiry, UTC. References are scoped to this API key.

form_fields.description: Six exact-case names sharing one common base and suffixes a/b/c/d/f/z, in captured insertion order. No separator is assumed. Values are opaque UTF-8 strings of at most 16 KiB each, without C0 control characters or DEL; d may be empty. One complete family is required.

form_body.description: Telemetry only, encoded once with native URLSearchParams in form_fields order. Contains no application fields. Preserve this raw string when prepending it to request.body. Must exactly serialize form_fields; at most 256 KiB UTF-8.

path.description: Optional execution path. Use fallback_reason to detect fallback, not generation time.

material_reuse.description: Whether the resolved source material was reused.

discovery_duration_ms.description: Optional learning duration in milliseconds, including fractional values.

discovery_state.description: Optional learning state; current values include not_started, pending, complete, failed and restored.

fallback_reason.description: Non-null means a fallback was used. Contact support with request_id about the mapping issue.

fallback_message.description: Optional safe guidance when a fallback is used.

material_ref.description: Existing key-scoped source reference; alone it does not establish Rust readiness.

Preparation.description: Optional asynchronous preparation of explicit material. Ready means usable validated output and acknowledged publication for the supplied context. Defaulted internal records are accepted when outputs remain valid. Lost eligibility invalidates readiness. Waiting never starts generation or spends generation credits.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Source page URL for the supplied material. References must match their original source URL.

scripts.description: Complete ordered JavaScript, 1–16 scripts, 2 MiB each / 3 MiB total. Supply scripts or material_ref, never both.

material_ref.description: Private API-key-scoped source reference used instead of scripts.

document_cookie.title: Document Cookie
document_cookie.description: JavaScript-visible cookies only, at most 16 KiB; never retained in material cache.

mode.description: Header mode (the default) returns HTTP telemetry headers. Form mode runs form instrumentation and returns body fields.

form.description: Form mode only. Optional observed form ID and name; omitting this object creates the selected form without either attribute.

ExplicitShapeRequest.title: ExplicitShapeRequest

content_type.description: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, optionally with one UTF-8 charset parameter.

body.description: Exact encoded application body before telemetry insertion; an empty string is permitted. At most 256 KiB UTF-8, 1,024 decoded pairs and 256 UTF-8 bytes per field name. Preserve duplicate fields, order and empty values. Malformed percent escapes, invalid UTF-8, NUL and a complete stale telemetry family are rejected.

ExplicitShapeRequest.description: Optional preparation input: full context with scripts or material_ref. Material omission is invalid on this route.
